text_block_list.name: Popular Idol
text_block_list.text: Three! Two! One! Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Pheeew!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wow! That was a fantastic New Year's Eve concert!
Today, Smart Falcon has brought me along to ring in the new year at a popular idol's concert.
While the concert itself was nothing short of fantastic, staying out all night has taken its toll on me. Smart Falcon, on the other hand, seems to have grown even more energized by the experience.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: She really packed that concert full of everything that makes her popular, don't you think?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Her singing and dancing were on a whole different level! She stole my heart and I'll never get it back!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I want to become an Umadol who people want to spend their New Year's with too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: No, I will become that kind of Umadol! ☆ This year, I'm gonna sing and dance with everything I've got! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That goes without saying!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: My resolution this year is the same as every other year—to become a top Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna keep on winning, taking center stage, and shining eeeven brighter! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm feeling super pumped from the concert earlier, so why don't we do idol stuff all day?! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Let's figure out exactly what it is that makes idols shine! And to do that…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Should we go to more concerts? Or should we do some visualization training? Or how about some research?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: What do you think?
…They all sound rough after the all-nighter we pulled, but it's not like I can just ignore her enthusiasm. I'll have to go with…
choice_data_list: Concerts! Let's turn this outing into an idol marathon!
Sleep! You can practice for the idol life in your dreams!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit, Trainer! I like your attitude and I'm with you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Let's see what concerts are on today with tickets left! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm all fired up! Let's go!
After that, we go watch any and all New Year's concerts we can find.
We end up pulling a magnificent twenty-four-hour concert marathon!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Phewww! ♪ All right, Trainer, let's head to the next one!
…Twenty-four hours and counting, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …What?! Sleep?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You can do visualization training while you sleep?
choice_data_list: An Umadol must train even their subconscious mind!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I-I don't get it entirely, but I think you might be on to something!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Got it! I'll become the perfect Umadol in my dreams!
And so, I'm able to spend a restful New Year…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Great idea! ♪ How about we go to a karaoke room?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I've saved a ton of idol videos we can use for reference!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: They let you play videos and rent DVDs at karaoke. I can tell you all about my favorite idols!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: See this group? They're known for being technical, so they're all great at singing! I think there's a lot I can learn from them! For example…
After that, we head to a place where we can play videos and I enjoy Idols 101 with Professor Falco.
